sentences.text: Welcome back to the workshop, where we turn raw footage into finished films.
sentences.ref_zh: 欢迎回到工作坊，我们在这里把原始素材变成成片。

sentences.text: Today I will show you three simple tricks that save about two hours of editing time.
sentences.ref_zh: 今天我会演示三个简单的小技巧，能省下大约两个小时的剪辑时间。

sentences.text: First, always cut on the beat, because rhythm is what keeps the audience awake.
sentences.ref_zh: 第一，永远在节拍上剪，因为节奏才能让观众保持清醒。

sentences.text: Second, remove the silent gaps longer than half a second before you touch the colors.
sentences.ref_zh: 第二，在碰调色之前，先把长度超过半秒的静音空隙去掉。

sentences.text: Third, normalize the audio to minus sixteen LUFS, which is the standard for online video platforms.
sentences.ref_zh: 第三，把音频响度归一到负十六 LUFS，这是在线视频平台的标准。

sentences.text: Finally, export at fifteen megabits per second, and never trust the first render.
sentences.ref_zh: 最后，以每秒十五兆的码率导出，而且永远不要相信第一次渲染。

sentences.text: That is it for this episode, see you in the next one.
sentences.ref_zh: 本期就到这里，我们下期见。

script: Welcome back to the workshop, where we turn raw footage into finished films. Today I will show you three simple tricks that save about two hours of editing time. First, always cut on the beat, because rhythm is what keeps the audience awake. Second, remove the silent gaps longer than half a second before you touch the colors. Third, normalize the audio to minus sixteen LUFS, which is the standard for online video platforms. Finally, export at fifteen megabits per second, and never trust the first render. That is it for this episode, see you in the next one.
